hypothesis: In a causally observable bull market and broadly advancing PIT industry, a prior-session bottom-quartile industry laggard's first liquid, high-close active-demand day may mark leader-to-follower capital diffusion and subsequent catch-up rather than crowded leader chasing.

novelty_boundary.different_from_prior_breakout_family: No rolling-high, platform-high, stale-resistance, gap, limit-up, or price-breakout condition is used.
novelty_boundary.different_from_prior_pullback_family: The pre-existing structure is relative underparticipation inside an advancing industry, not a visual support touch or absolute pullback threshold.
novelty_boundary.different_from_failed_bull_engine: The candidate must be a prior-session industry laggard; already-leading quiet-inventory breakouts are excluded by construction.

causal_market_state.definition: market_median_ret20 > 0 and market_median_ret60 > 0 and market_positive_ret20_share > 0.5 and market_positive_ret60_share > 0.5

pre_existing_industry_structure.identity: causal_industry with non-null industry_snapshot_id and industry_valid/historical_identity_valid
pre_existing_industry_structure.comment: The laggard state is frozen from the completed prior session; the active-demand signal bar cannot create its own laggard qualification.

first_active_demand_event.decision_at: signal session close after all registered daily inputs are available

frozen_execution_anatomy.entry: first legal, non-limit-up open in signal+1 through signal+3
frozen_execution_anatomy.exit: 15 percent coordinate-price target or first legal open after 30 held sessions
frozen_execution_anatomy.cost: 20 bps per side, 40 bps round trip
frozen_execution_anatomy.corporate_action_contract: QD-010 exact coordinate lineage; fail closed on lineage change
